headline: A 1996 order by President Clinton changed an earlier executive order, No. 12580, which deals with how the federal Superfund cleanup law is carried out.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12580, an earlier order that assigns duties under the federal Superfund law for cleaning up hazardous waste sites. The title does not say what specific changes were made. No summary was provided, so the details of the change are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle hazardous waste cleanup
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the earlier rules that assign their cleanup duties, but the specific changes are not described in the source.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on August 28, 1996, though the source does not say.
